_comment: Hand classification of the ToolsPanel tags whose items sit inside helper components, which the AST reader cannot see through. Key: file + symbol + label + index (nth tag with that file, symbol and label). Read by scripts/check-reset-only-menus.js. A ToolsPanel with direct ToolsPanelItem children is classified from its isShownByDefault flags, never from this file.

panels.label: Settings
panels.why: Items sit in helper components, so the class was read by hand (Stage E2 survey from i23 section 1): every item is shown by default, so the menu only resets
